title: Mother and Toddler Walking, 1940s B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-20th-century candid snapshot featuring a mother standing behind her young toddler, holding their hands as the child takes steps along an open road edge. The mother is dressed in a long, heavy double-breasted overcoat typical of the late 1940s fashion. The toddler wears a knit hat, jacket, and folded trousers. In the background, bare trees and a rustic wooden road sign are visible under a clear sky. The photo has scalloped/deckled edges typical of post-war vernacular photography.
